limitations: This pure module receives caller-attested readback bytes/clocks. It cannot authenticate an I/O event or guarantee atomic replacement without the separately reviewed producer integration.
Freshness, complete registered inventory, exact pip/forecast/ledger/entry/target validity and execution authority remain downstream checks.
No claim is made here that a running producer has adopted the new boundary or that an observed outage was fixed.
Any deployment requires a separate registration/source binding; existing frozen sources and cohorts were not modified.
review_scope: Bounded independent read-only source/test inspection; no independent test rerun, raw live envelope read, producer modification or runtime integration.
reviewed_boundaries: Canonical immutable bytes/scalars detach the sealed snapshot from caller mutable dictionaries.
All public use boundaries revalidate snapshot schema, authority, payload seal and byte/scalar identity.
Written/readback bytes must match the admitted snapshot exactly; completion must not precede original generation.
Only caller-acknowledged PublishedSummary supplies heartbeat hash and snapshot-dependent counts, preserving original row and target clocks.
Caller replaces the prior PublishedSummary only after successful write and readback; failures cannot acknowledge a new generation through this API.
Returned heartbeat count dictionaries are freshly derived and cannot mutate retained snapshot bytes.
Clock, shape, recursion, string, node, pair, family and canonical-byte limits reject malformed input.
Envelope counts explicitly remain original snapshot statuses rather than live ledger or target eligibility.
